    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#.NET源生成器作用域及“千人千面”</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一cnet源生成器作用域">一、C#.NET源生成器作用域</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>依赖开源项目nuget包: Hand.Generators.EasySyntax --version 0.3.1.1-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-生成简单类">1. 生成简单类</h3>
<h4 id="11-简单类的示例">1.1 简单类的示例</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>命名空间Models会解析为作用域NamespaceScope(ISyntaxScope)</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator对应一个类,可以给类添加成员</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("User");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var id = SyntaxGenerator.IntType.GetInitProperty("Id").Public();
generator.AddProperty(id);
var name = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.GetInitProperty("Name").Public();
generator.AddProperty(name);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-简单类示例生成代码如下">1.2 简单类示例生成代码如下</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models
{
    class User
    {
        public int Id { get; init; }
        public string Name { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-同作用域命名空间生成多个类">2. 同作用域(命名空间)生成多个类</h3>
<h4 id="21-多个类的示例">2.1 多个类的示例</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>一个作用域ISyntaxScope内可以包含多个类</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("User");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var userIdType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId");
var userIdGenerator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(generator.Container, SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration(userIdType.Identifier));
var userIdValue = SyntaxGenerator.IntType.GetInitProperty("Value").Public();
userIdGenerator.AddProperty(userIdValue);
var userNameType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserName");
var userNameGenerator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(generator.Container, SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration(userNameType.Identifier));
var userNameValue = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.GetInitProperty("Value").Public();
userNameGenerator.AddProperty(userNameValue);
var id = userIdType.GetInitProperty("Id").Public();
generator.AddProperty(id);
var name = userNameType.GetInitProperty("Name").Public();
generator.AddProperty(name);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-多个类示例生成代码如下">2.2 多个类示例生成代码如下</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models
{
    class User
    {
        public UserId Id { get; init; }
        public UserName Name { get; init; }
    }

    class UserId
    {
        public int Value { get; init; }
    }

    class UserName
    {
        public string Value { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-生成嵌套内部类">3. 生成嵌套内部类</h3>
<h4 id="31-内部类的示例">3.1 内部类的示例</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>不指定命名空间也会构建作用域UnitScope(ISyntaxScope),对应语法树的CompilationUnitSyntax</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator继承了接口ISyntaxScope</li>
<li>以SyntaxGenerator(类)为作用域添加类就能生成内部类,SyntaxGenerator支持嵌套</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var outerClass = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("OuterClass");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(outerClass);
var outerValue = SyntaxGenerator.IntType.GetInitProperty("OuterValue").Public();
generator.AddProperty(outerValue);
var innerClass = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("InnerClass");
var innerGenerator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(generator, innerClass);
var innerValue = SyntaxGenerator.IntType.GetInitProperty("InnerValue").Public();
innerGenerator.AddProperty(innerValue);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-内部类示例生成代码如下">3.2 内部类示例生成代码如下</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class OuterClass
{
    public int OuterValue { get; init; }

    class InnerClass
    {
        public int InnerValue { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="二简单命名展示">二、简单命名展示</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>依赖nuget包: Hand.Generators.EasySyntax --version 0.3.1.1-alpha</li>
<li>使用SyntaxGenerator.Simplify简化类型名</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-自动using">1. 自动using</h3>
<h4 id="11-自动using命名空间示例">1.1 自动using命名空间示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Comment");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var id = generator.Simplify(SyntaxGenerator.GuidType).GetInitProperty("Id").Public();
generator.AddProperty(id);
var content = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.GetInitProperty("Content").Public();
generator.AddProperty(content);
var addTime = generator.Simplify(SyntaxGenerator.DateTimeType).GetInitProperty("AddTime").Public();
generator.AddProperty(addTime);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-自动using命名空间示例生成代码">1.2 自动using命名空间示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>自动using命名System</li>
<li>相同命名空间自动排重</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using System;

namespace Models
{
    class Comment
    {
        public Guid Id { get; init; }
        public string Content { get; init; }
        public DateTime AddTime { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-相同命名空间">2. 相同命名空间</h3>
<h4 id="21-相同命名空间示例">2.1 相同命名空间示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var userIdType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId").Qualify(scope);
var userNameType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserName").Qualify(scope);
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("User");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var id = generator.Simplify(userIdType).GetInitProperty("Id").Public();
generator.AddProperty(id);
var name = generator.Simplify(userNameType).GetInitProperty("Name").Public();
generator.AddProperty(name);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-相同命名空间示例生成代码">2.2 相同命名空间示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>相同命名不用增加using</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models
{
    class User
    {
        public UserId Id { get; init; }
        public UserName Name { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-同名类处理">3. 同名类处理</h3>
<h4 id="31-同名类示例">3.1 同名类示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var customerType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("User").Qualify(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Customers"));
var managerType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("User").Qualify(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Managers"));
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Flow");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("OA"), type);
var submitter = generator.Simplify(customerType).GetInitProperty("Submitter").Public();
generator.AddProperty(submitter);
var approver = generator.Simplify(managerType).GetInitProperty("Approver").Public();
generator.AddProperty(approver);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-同名类示例生成代码">3.2 同名类示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Customers.User提交,简化为User并添加using Customers;</li>
<li>管理用户审批,由于User已占用只能全名展示</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using Customers;

namespace OA
{
    class Flow
    {
        public User Submitter { get; init; }
        public Managers.User Approver { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-同名类异常情况">4. 同名类异常情况</h3>
<h4 id="41-同名类异常示例">4.1 同名类异常示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var customerScope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Customers");
var customerId = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId").Qualify(customerScope);
var customerName = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserName").Qualify(customerScope);
var managerScope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Managers");
var managerId = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId").Qualify(managerScope);
var managerName = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserName").Qualify(managerScope);
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Flow");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("OA"), type);
var submitterId = generator.Simplify(customerId).GetInitProperty("SubmitterId").Public();
generator.AddProperty(submitterId);
var approverName = generator.Simplify(managerName).GetInitProperty("ApproverName").Public();
generator.AddProperty(approverName);
var submitterName = generator.Simplify(customerName).GetInitProperty("SubmitterId").Public();
generator.AddProperty(submitterName);
var approverId = generator.Simplify(managerId).GetInitProperty("SubmitterId").Public();
generator.AddProperty(approverId);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-同名类异常示例生成代码">4.2 同名类异常示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>虽然代码可以生成,但生成的代码无法通过编译</li>
<li>SubmitterId和ApproverName的类重名导致不明确</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using Customers;
using Managers;

namespace OA
{
    class Flow
    {
        public UserId SubmitterId { get; init; }
        public UserName ApproverName { get; init; }
        public Customers.UserName SubmitterId { get; init; }
        public Managers.UserId SubmitterId { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-简单命名功能总结">5. 简单命名功能总结</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>集成在SyntaxGenerator中,自动适应当前类型作用域(命名空间)</li>
<li>使用简单</li>
<li>生成代码最简洁</li>
<li>有同名类(不同命名空间)冲突机制</li>
<li>相同命名空间多个同名类还是可能生成编译无法通过的代码</li>
<li>包含命名空间下未使用的同名类也可能导致无法编译</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="三差异命名展示">三、差异命名展示</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>依赖开源项目nuget包: Hand.Generators.Tidy --version 0.3.1.1-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-命名空间不同">1. 命名空间不同</h3>
<h4 id="11-命名空间不同示例">1.1 命名空间不同示例</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>按命名空间生成作用域TypeSimplifier(ITypeSimplifier)对象</li>
<li>Simplify方法根据两个命名空间最短距离简化类名展示</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Comment");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var simplifier = TypeSimplifier.Create(scope);
var id = simplifier.Simplify(SyntaxGenerator.GuidType).GetInitProperty("Id").Public();
generator.AddProperty(id);
var content = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.GetInitProperty("Content").Public();
generator.AddProperty(content);
var addTime = simplifier.Simplify(SyntaxGenerator.DateTimeType).GetInitProperty("AddTime").Public();
generator.AddProperty(addTime);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-命名空间不同示例生成代码">1.2 命名空间不同示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>命名空间Models和System没有相同的根,无法简化,完整展示</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models
{
    class Comment
    {
        public System.Guid Id { get; init; }
        public string Content { get; init; }
        public System.DateTime AddTime { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-命名空间相同">2. 命名空间相同</h3>
<h4 id="21-命名空间相同示例">2.1 命名空间相同示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Comment");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var simplifier = TypeSimplifier.Create(scope);
var id = simplifier.Simplify(SyntaxGenerator.GuidType).GetInitProperty("Id").Public();
generator.AddProperty(id);
var content = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.GetInitProperty("Content").Public();
generator.AddProperty(content);
var addTime = simplifier.Simplify(SyntaxGenerator.DateTimeType).GetInitProperty("AddTime").Public();
generator.AddProperty(addTime);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-命名空间相同示例生成代码">2.2 命名空间相同示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>User的作用域与UserId和UserName重叠,命名空间完全简化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models
{
    class User
    {
        public UserId Id { get; init; }
        public UserName Name { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-命名空间包含">3. 命名空间包含</h3>
<h4 id="31-命名空间包含示例">3.1 命名空间包含示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var userIdType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId").Qualify(scope);
var scope2 = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("CMS").Qualify(scope);
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Comment");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope2, type);
var simplifier = TypeSimplifier.Create(scope2);
var userId = simplifier.Simplify(userIdType).GetInitProperty("UserId").Public();
generator.AddProperty(userId);
var content = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.GetInitProperty("Content").Public();
generator.AddProperty(content);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-命名空间包含示例生成代码">3.2 命名空间包含示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Comment作用域Models.CMS包含于UserId的作用域Models,UserId的命名空间可以完全简化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models.CMS
{
    class Comment
    {
        public UserId UserId { get; init; }
        public string Content { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-命名空间部分包含">4. 命名空间部分包含</h3>
<h4 id="41-命名空间部分包含示例">4.1 命名空间部分包含示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope0 = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var scope1 = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Accounts").Qualify(scope0);
var userIdType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId").Qualify(scope1);
var scope2 = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("CMS").Qualify(scope0);
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Comment");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope2, type);
var simplifier = TypeSimplifier.Create(scope2);
var userId = simplifier.Simplify(userIdType).GetInitProperty("UserId").Public();
generator.AddProperty(userId);
var content = SyntaxGenerator.StringType.GetInitProperty("Content").Public();
generator.AddProperty(content);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-命名空间部分包含示例生成代码">4.2 命名空间部分包含示例生成代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Comment和UserId有公共的根Models,公共部分可以简化</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models.CMS
{
    class Comment
    {
        public Accounts.UserId UserId { get; init; }
        public string Content { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-差异命名功能总结">5. 差异命名功能总结</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这里的差异命名于Visual Studio的代码提示几乎一致</li>
<li>存在以上情况Visual Studio也会把可以简化部分变灰并给出提示</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="四全局命名展示">四、全局命名展示</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>全局命名展示功能也包含在nuget包: Hand.Generators.Tidy --version 0.3.1.1-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-简单全名">1. 简单全名</h3>
<h4 id="11-简单全名示例">1.1 简单全名示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var userIdType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserId");
var userNameType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("UserName");
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("User");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var simplifier = GlobalScope.Instance;
var id = simplifier.Simplify(userIdType).GetInitProperty("Id").Public();
generator.AddProperty(id);
var name = simplifier.Simplify(userNameType).GetInitProperty("Name").Public();
generator.AddProperty(name);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-简单全名示例生成代码">1.2 简单全名示例生成代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models
{
    class User
    {
        public global::UserId Id { get; init; }
        public global::UserName Name { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-泛型全名">2. 泛型全名</h3>
<h4 id="21-泛型全名示例">2.1 泛型全名示例</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var scope = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Models");
var orderItemType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("OrderItem").Qualify(scope);
var orderItemsType = SyntaxGenerator.ListType(orderItemType);
var type = SyntaxFactory.ClassDeclaration("Order");
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Create(scope, type);
var simplifier = GlobalScope.Instance;
var items = simplifier.Simplify(orderItemsType).GetInitProperty("Items").Public();
generator.AddProperty(items);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-泛型全名示例生成代码">2.2 泛型全名示例生成代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace Models
{
    class Order
    {
        public global::System.Collections.Generic.List&lt;global::Models.OrderItem&gt; Items { get; init; }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五示例说明">五、示例说明</h2>
<h3 id="1-示例执行说明">1. 示例执行说明</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以上代码执行依赖开源项目Hand.Generators.EasySyntax和Hand.Generators.Tidy</li>
<li>Hand.Generators.EasySyntax --version 0.3.1.1-alpha</li>
<li>Hand.Generators.Tidy --version 0.3.1.1-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-handgeneratorseasysyntax和handgeneratorstidy示例代码及开源源码">2. Hand.Generators.EasySyntax和Hand.Generators.Tidy示例代码及开源源码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>github仓库: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net</a></li>
<li>gitee同步更新: <a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="六最佳实践总结">六、最佳实践总结</h2>
<h3 id="1-两种作用域">1. 两种作用域</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ISyntaxScope作用域用来包含类</li>
<li>ITypeSimplifier作用域用来计算命名(类及命空间的路径)</li>
<li>其中SyntaxGenerator实现的以上两个接口</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-三种命名方式对比">2. 三种命名方式对比</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以下是三种命名规则的对比</li>
<li>哪种规则更适合需要结合具体情况</li>
<li>当然多种命名方式混合使用也是可以的</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">命名方式</th>
<th style="text-align: left">简洁度</th>
<th style="text-align: left">安全性</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">简单命名</td>
<td style="text-align: left">最简洁</td>
<td style="text-align: left">重名类过多风险高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">相对命名</td>
<td style="text-align: left">较为简洁</td>
<td style="text-align: left">也存在重名类风险,风险较小</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">全局命名</td>
<td style="text-align: left">不简洁</td>
<td style="text-align: left">没有风险</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
